thread:
ryan: Launching canary->prod for v2.15.2 at 12:30 UTC. Starting post-deploy smoke: synth-small, kv-prefill, embed-consistency across us/eu. Keep eyes on p95 and 5xx.

deploy-bot: rollout started: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.15.2 mode=staggered postdeploy=enabled.

leah: seeing synth-small p95 in eu-west1 jump 200ms->900ms, a couple 502s reported.

marty: logs: `[2026-03-26T12:31:45Z] synth id=sg-44 lat=912ms status=502 host=prefill-6` Might be kv misses.

opsbot: synth summary job=sg-44 samples=60 p95=890ms errors=2 mean=320ms

ryan: pause wave. hold canary weight. marty, try a route pin to v2.15.1 in eu-west1 (dry-run then apply) to see if it stabilizes.

marty: dry-run: `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.15.2 --to v2.15.1 --dry-run --reason "postdeploy synth p95 spike"`

deploy-bot: dry-run OK.

marty: applying pin now: `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.15.2 --to v2.15.1 --reason "postdeploy synth p95 spike"` 

deploy-bot: action=route-pin status=applied service=inference-api region=eu-west1 pinned_to=v2.15.1 actor=marty ts=3325001280

opsbot: re-run synth summary after pin: samples=70 p95=240ms errors=0 mean=200ms

leah: looks stable in eu. us-west still nominal. Recommend hold 20m then resume with expanded warmup in eu.

ryan: decision: hold global ramp for 20m; add release note amendment: eu pinned to v2.15.1 due to postdeploy synth p95 spike. Create follow-up ticket to investigate kv-prefill warmup (assign infra). If errors >5% or p95 >25% from baseline, open incident.

marty: filing ticket INF-8007 and linking traces. updating change window doc.

ryan: closing thread, will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
